items.title: Pay invoice for painting work
items.quote: Bitte überweisen Sie den Betrag innerhalb von 14 Tagen nach Erhalt dieser Rechnung auf unser Konto.
items.computation: The 14-day payment period runs from receipt of the invoice ('nach Erhalt dieser Rechnung'), not from the invoice's own date. The letter, however, prints no invoice date at all - only the date the painting work was completed (12.08.2026). Without a printed or otherwise known issue/mailing date, the actual date of receipt by the recipient cannot be established, so the start of the §187 BGB period is unknown and the 14-day count (which would end on a working day per §193 BGB if it fell on a weekend/holiday) cannot be reliably computed. As an earliest plausible estimate, if the invoice were issued and received on the same day as project completion (12.08.2026), the 14-day period (day of receipt not counted, ending 14 days later) would run 13.08.2026-26.08.2026, i.e. Wednesday 26.08.2026 (a working day, no adjustment needed) - but this rests on an unverified assumption about the receipt date.
